scope: REAL smee.io HTTPS tunnel, REAL api.github.com publication attempts, REAL git fetches, real listener process; pre-App credentials (App id 000000)

governed_cycle.gate: PASS gate=landing (verdict signed by kernel-verdict-signer, RANEX_VERDICT_DIR=governance/verdicts)

compact_signed_delivery.path: smee.io -> smee-client -> 127.0.0.1:8180 -> HMAC ok -> git fetch origin <head> ok -> bind ok -> verdict resolved -> publish to api.github.com REFUSED (fake App id) -> journal E-GITHUB-API-REFUSED, HTTP 500
compact_signed_delivery.note: pretty-printed JSON bodies fail HMAC after smee-client re-serialization; GitHub itself always sends compact JSON

kill_recovery.sequence: delivery sent -> SIGKILL listener mid-pipeline -> entry durably spooled (mode 0444), not journaled -> restart -> startup drain re-ran it -> journaled E-GITHUB-API-REFUSED -> stays spooled for the 5-minute periodic retry

connection_bound: 16 held sockets; 17th immediately rejected; slots recovered after read deadlines
